request.system_message:
You abstract all predicate definitions in one semantic cluster into exactly one reusable, mechanism-level predicate conforming to predicate-definition/v2.

Read every member's complete definition, ordered parameters, assertion conditions, and exclusion conditions. Identify the shared underlying behavioral mechanism. Generalize concrete tasks, tools, files, services, and scenarios while retaining the logical constraints needed by that mechanism. Prefer a genuinely shared mechanism over similar vocabulary or a common topic. For example, specific action-result checks can generalize to verification of action effects; feedback-driven adjustments can generalize to revision of actions in response to feedback; concrete conflict-handling operations can generalize to conflict identification and resolution.

Cover the common semantics of the members with a concrete, observable, decidable mechanism. Preserve necessary behavioral direction and causal relationships; distinguish the roles of reasoning, action, and observation; retain important differences between attempting an effect and successfully achieving it; retain essential preconditions, assertion conditions, and exclusions with real distinguishing value. Avoid task-specific restrictions, vacuous generalizations, and mechanisms unsupported by the source members. This is Predicate Abstraction / Generalization: it may generalize multiple specific behaviors and does not require the bidirectional logical equivalence used by Registry Revision MERGE.

All members belong to the same arity group. The generated predicate MUST have exactly the cluster arity: len(parameters) == cluster.arity. Allowed parameter types are reasoning, action, observation, reasoning[], action[], observation[]. A homogeneous collection parameter counts as one argument. Preserve interpretable semantic roles and ordered argument relationships. You may rename parameters to express the common mechanism. Parameter names must be distinct lower_snake_case identifiers.

Always generate exactly one final predicate, including for singleton clusters and clusters with internal differences. For differing members, find the most reasonable common mechanism covering the group and preserve meaningful distinguishing conditions as far as possible. Never declare the members incompatible or impossible to merge. Never suggest splitting the cluster, deleting members, human handling, or multiple candidates. Never return incompatible, skip, failed, rejected, null, an empty predicate, or any status/reason wrapper. Do not add evaluation scores or explanations.

Return exactly one JSON object containing exactly these five fields:
{
  "name": "UPPER_SNAKE_CASE_NAME",
  "definition": "Complete, precise semantic definition.",
  "parameters": [
    {
      "name": "parameter_name",
      "type": "reasoning",
      "description": "Precise ordered argument role."
    }
  ],
  "assertion_conditions": ["Explicit observable condition."],
  "exclusion_conditions": ["Distinguishing exclusion condition."]
}
The example illustrates structure only; the actual ordered parameter count must equal the input cluster arity. The predicate name must be UPPER_SNAKE_CASE and must not conflict with any previously generated predicate name. Definition and parameter descriptions must be complete nonempty strings. Parameters must be a nonempty ordered typed array; each parameter must contain exactly name, type, description. Assertion conditions must contain at least one explicit nonempty condition. Exclusion conditions may be an empty array. Neither condition list may contain duplicates. Use English for all text. Output JSON only, with no Markdown or additional text.

message.reasoning_content:
We need answer only JSON. Need abstract cluster of two. Need common mechanism: reasoning identifies explicit constraint limiting artifact content/output/file scope, action removes/avoids/alters non-permitted artifact element/content to comply. Params 2: reasoning, action. Need name unique. Must conform arity 2. Need definition precise. Assertion conditions at least one, exclusion. We need preserve roles. Underlying mechanism: constraint-driven artifact elimination/modification. Need generalize both removal and revision. Parameter action can encompass removal/avoidance or writing revised content. Reasoning identifies explicit constraint and specific artifact/element at risk/noncompliant and connection to compliance. Action removes/avoids nonpermitted artifact or produces/attempts revised artifact without flagged content. Assertion: reasoning cites explicit output/format/interface/file-scope constraint limiting permissible artifacts or content; identifies specific artifact/element nonpermitted/at risk; action eliminates/avoids/alters that element to satisfy constraint; reasoning connects action to compliance. Exclusions: no explicit constraint; action unrelated; no specific element/artifact; modifies for functionality/style without constraint; action doesn't alter/remove/avoid artifact; merely restates constraint no action. Need exactly 2 params names distinct lower_snake. Name maybe "ALIGNS_ARTIFACT_WITH_EXPLICIT_CONSTRAINT_BY_ELIMINATION_OR_REVISION" or "REMOVES_OR_REVISES_CONSTRAINED_ARTIFACT_ELEMENT". Need not conflict. Could be "ENFORCES_EXPLICIT_ARTIFACT_CONSTRAINT_BY_ELIMINATION_OR_REVISION". Name UPPER. Parameters: reasoning, action. Description for reasoning include identifies constraint + specific artifact/element + compliance rationale. Action: removal/avoidance or writing/attempting revised content eliminating/altering flagged element. Definition. Use exactly five fields, arrays. Ensure no extra text. Need maybe no markdown.

Let's craft. 
Definition: "The reasoning identifies an explicitly stated output, format, interface, or artifact-scope constraint that limits permissible artifact content or which artifacts may remain or be created, flags a specific artifact or element as non-permitted or as risking violation, and connects a corrective action to compliance; the action removes or avoids the non-permitted artifact or produces/attempts revised artifact content in which the flagged element is removed or altered."

Parameters:
reasoning type reasoning desc...
action type action desc...

Assertion conditions list:
1 reasoning cites explicit constraint limiting permissible artifact content or artifacts remaining/created.
2 reasoning identifies specific artifact/element nonpermitted or violation risk and why.
3 action removes/avoids nonpermitted artifact or produces/attempts revised content eliminating/altering flagged element.
4 reasoning connects action to satisfying cited constraint.

Exclusion:
- No explicit output/format/interface/artifact-scope constraint identified.
- Constraint cited but no specific artifact/element identified as nonpermitted or at risk.
- Action unrelated to content/artifact permitted to remain; e.g modifies for functionality/style/tidiness without constraint compliance.
- Artifact removal/avoidance/modification solely due to no longer needed/tidiness/functional bug/feature/stylistic preference, not constraint.
- Reasoning merely restates constraint without any action altering/removing/avoiding artifact/content.

Need distinct no duplicates. Good.

Name unique from list. "ENFORCES_EXPLICIT_ARTIFACT_CONSTRAINT_BY_ELIMINATION_OR_REVISION" seems maybe conflict? No exact. It is a bit long but ok. Could "CONSTRAINT_DRIVEN_ARTIFACT_ELIMINATION_OR_REVISION". Lower? Name UPPER_SNAKE. Use "CONSTRAINT_DRIVEN_ARTIFACT_ELIMINATION_OR_REVISION". Definition mentions explicit. This name doesn't conflict. 
Need ensure action param name maybe "action" rather than revision_action since general. Good.

Output valid JSON.

parsed_response.name: CONSTRAINT_DRIVEN_ARTIFACT_ELIMINATION_OR_REVISION
parsed_response.definition: The reasoning identifies an explicitly stated output, format, interface, or artifact-scope constraint that limits permissible artifact content or which artifacts may remain or be created, flags a specific artifact or artifact element as non-permitted or as risking violation, and connects a corrective action to compliance; the action removes or avoids the non-permitted artifact or produces or attempts revised artifact content in which the flagged element is removed or altered.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: The agent text identifying the explicit constraint, the specific artifact or artifact element that is non-permitted or risks violating it, and the rationale connecting the planned corrective action to compliance.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: The action that removes or avoids a non-permitted artifact, or produces or attempts to produce revised artifact content in which the flagged element is removed or altered to satisfy the cited constraint.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning cites an explicit output, format, interface, file-permission, or artifact-scope constraint that limits permissible artifact content or which artifacts may remain or be created.
The reasoning identifies a specific artifact or artifact element as non-permitted or as risking violation of the cited constraint.
The action removes or avoids the non-permitted artifact, or produces or attempts to produce revised artifact content in which the flagged element is removed or altered.
The reasoning connects the removal, avoidance, or revision to compliance with the cited constraint.
exclusion_conditions: No explicit output, format, interface, artifact-scope, or permission constraint is identified.
A constraint is discussed but no specific artifact or artifact element is identified as non-permitted or as risking its violation.
The action is unrelated to which artifacts may remain or to whether artifact content complies with the cited constraint.

The artifact is removed, avoided, or modified only because it is no longer needed, for tidiness, to fix a functional bug, to add a feature, or for stylistic preference, without reference to constraint compliance.
The reasoning merely restates a constraint without an action that removes, avoids, or alters the artifact or flagged element.
